label: US equities
reason: SPY holds the S&P 500, the index whose options VIX is computed from.

label: US tech
reason: QQQ holds the Nasdaq-100, the index whose options VXN is computed from.

label: US small caps
reason: IWM holds the Russell 2000, the index whose options RVX is computed from.

label: Gold
reason: GVZ is computed from options on GLD itself.

label: Oil
reason: OVX is computed from options on USO itself, so USO's own roll losses are in both sides.

label: Emerging markets
reason: VXEEM is computed from options on EEM itself.

label: Bitcoin
reason: DVOL is computed from Deribit's BTC options; Binance BTCUSDT minute bars give the realized side, and USDT's moves against the dollar are three orders of magnitude smaller than bitcoin's.
